title: Refining Guide
summary: The basics of refining equipment and how to refine.

blocks.text: Refining improves equipment. Depending on the equipment type it raises ATK, DEF, MATK and more, and some equipment gains extra effects at high refine levels.
Regular equipment can be refined safely up to +4. Within the safe range, a failed refine does not destroy the equipment.
Refine weapons with Oridecon and armor with Elunium. The higher the refine level, the lower the success rate.
Enriched Elunium and Enriched Oridecon give a higher success rate than regular refining. The equipment can still break on failure.

items: For expensive equipment, using a Blacksmith's Blessing is recommended.
Refine bonuses can differ from one piece of equipment to another.
Some equipment unlocks strong options above a certain refine level.
The success rate depends on the refine level.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Some equipment may follow different rules from regular refining, and the refining system may change with events or updates.
